title: Busy Days on Broadway Quiet Nights on the Rooftop
description:
Unwind on your private rooftop - walk to The Truth or 3 minute Uber to Broadway.

Want a quiet spot to retreat to after enjoying all that Nashville has to offer?  This place will welcome you home.  Close to all things Nashville - honky tonks on Broadway, TRUTH, WeHo, Geodis, Bridgestone, Nissan, the Parthenon and much more.  Here for work?  Easy access to I65 and I24 and close to Vanderbilt and several hospitals. 

Enjoy Music City, park free onsite, then chill on our private rooftop deck.

The space
From the private rooftop deck to the loft bedroom and full kitchen, this modern take on a row house is all you need to enjoy a quick get away in Music City.  Walk to Truth and WeHo

Open air controlled access parking pad for one vehicle. Street parking is also available, but be sure to read the parking signs.

Guest access
No keys to lose or to return! This property provides secure, keyless entry with an August Smart Lock. You can lock and unlock the door with your smartphone, using a unique virtual key, or personal entry code issued to you for the duration of your stay.

Park your vehicle in the private controlled access parking pad off the alley way.

Other things to note
Free on-site controlled access parking.  Please be sure to read street parking signs if using street parking.

Please note:  you may not receive mail at this property.  If during your temporary stay, you wish to have mail or packages sent or received, please use one of these options:

- Amazon Hub/Locker: Convenient for Amazon packages.
- UPS Store/Mailbox Services: Rent a temporary mailbox or have packages held for pickup.
- USPS General Delivery: Mail can be held at a local post office for pickup.
